turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Hey, I'm really sorry, but I have bad news. My manager asked me to finish a report tonight, so I can't leave until eight.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Oh no, but the match starts at seven! That's a shame. So you'll miss most of it?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: I know. From here to our café is about forty minutes. You could start watching without me.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I don't want to watch the whole match alone. Is there a café near your office? Then you could join me sooner.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: There's a good one across the street, with a big screen. I could be there at ten past eight. But it's far from your home.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That's okay, it's about thirty minutes by metro. I'd rather go a bit further and watch the second half together.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Great! I'll try to finish early. I'll send you the name of the café.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Perfect. So I'll be at the café near your office before seven, and you'll come at about ten past eight.
